project_metadata.description: A synthesized domain model for an e-commerce system, derived from bounded context analyses.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages customer profiles, authentication, and personal preferences like wishlists.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Represents a registered user of the system, holding core profile information.

entities.name: Wishlist
entities.description: A collection of products saved by a customer for future consideration.

value_objects.name: Address
value_objects.description: A physical location, used for customer billing or shipping.

value_objects.name: Email
value_objects.description: A customer's unique email address, used for communication and login.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product information, categories, and specifications.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A distinct item available for sale, identified by a unique SKU.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A classification for organizing products, potentially hierarchical.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: Specification
value_objects.description: A key-value pair describing a product attribute.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles the lifecycle of customer orders, from creation to shipping.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A customer's request to purchase one or more products.

entities.name: OrderItem
entities.description: A specific product and its quantity within an order.

value_objects.name: OrderStatus
value_objects.description: The current state of an order (e.g., Pending, Shipped, Cancelled).

bounded_contexts.description: Manages the stock levels of products across warehouses.

entities.name: StockLevel
entities.description: The quantity of a specific product available or reserved in a warehouse.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles financial transactions, including payments and refunds.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A record of a financial transaction for an order.

entities.name: Refund
entities.description: A record of money returned to a customer for a payment.

value_objects.name: PaymentMethodInfo
value_objects.description: Details of the payment instrument used for a transaction.

value_objects.name: PaymentStatus
value_objects.description: The current state of a payment (e.g., Pending, Completed, Failed).

value_objects.name: RefundStatus
value_objects.description: The current state of a refund (e.g., Requested, Processed, Failed).
